<thought>We need the precursors generated by applying template 1914385 to the target molecule COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. The previous step gave us the template ID, so we will use the apply_template tool. The result will be a list of SMILES strings; if each string contains multiple precursors separated by a dot, we will split them into individual components and return a list of lists as required.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O", "template_id": "1914385"}</action_input>
